items.failure: Block-sum coarse states are not generally lumpable under pairwise equalization.
items.lesson: Exact microscopic relaxation plus an additive invariant does not automatically provide a lawful refinement dynamics.

items.failure: Canonical normal forms fail to compose as raw representatives even though the signed quotient composes exactly.
items.lesson: Recoalescence may belong at N2 quotient level; forcing monoidal normal-form representatives would over-strengthen the ontology.

items.failure: The transitive carry cycle has no nonconstant invariant and no genuine relaxation; the endpoint orientation is N1.
items.lesson: Recurrence/fraction/order can be derived cleanly without paying conservation/relaxation, and an operational direction must not be promoted to N0.

items.failure: Global union is conserved but not extensive under composition with overlapping atom types.
items.lesson: Conservation is weaker than extensivity; D1 and the conservation part of D3 should not be merged semantically.

items.failure: Arbitrary transformation tables can encode patchwork; semigroup closure alone does not supply an invariant.
items.lesson: Low-description generator derivation is theorem-critical; a general finite operator table is too expressive to count as explanatory compression.

items.failure: Pure involutive swap dynamics cannot possess a strict branch-independent well-founded relaxation monotone.
items.lesson: Reversibility gives an exact no-go boundary for conservation+recurrence+strict relaxation and points to noninvertible quotient/rewrite extensions.
